--- grant_on_all_change_streams_in_default_schema.sql
GRANT SELECT ON ALL CHANGE STREAMS IN SCHEMA DEFAULT TO ROLE role1

--- AST
&ast.Grant{
  Privilege: &ast.SelectPrivilegeOnAllChangeStreamsInSchema{
    Select:  6,
    Default: 45,
  },
  Roles: []*ast.Ident{
    &ast.Ident{
      NamePos: 61,
      NameEnd: 66,
      Name:    "role1",
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
GRANT SELECT ON ALL CHANGE STREAMS IN SCHEMA DEFAULT TO ROLE role1
